name: cli-test-summary
description: A skill that has the agent run the tests through cli-test-summary and read the JSON: counts and every failure with file, line and message; failures re-run alone to tell real from flaky.

interface.shortDescription: Run the tests, get counts and failures as data
interface.longDescription: Runs the project's own test command (npm test, pytest, go test, cargo test, dotnet test) and answers with pass/fail counts and every failure with file, line and message, from the runner's machine-readable report. Failures can be re-run one by one to tell a real failure from a flaky one. node:test, vitest, jest, pytest, go, cargo and dotnet.
defaultPrompt: Run the tests and tell me what fails.
Is this failing test flaky or really broken?
Run the tests before we call this done.
